item.title: Survivor of Nazi experiments speaks at Morgan Hill event
item.description: Sora Vigorito was 3 years old when she and her twin sister were pulled from their grandmother’s arms at the gates of Auschwitz and handed to the infamous Nazi physician Josef Mengele.
